$comment: AFLDB-ISSUE-093 Stage B2-2 — the ONE authoritative DraftGuru event-kind mapping. Turns the accepted Stage A source label (parsed/rows.jsonl `event_type_raw`) into the canonical draft_picks.draft_type and draft_picks.draft_kind, and pins the signing derivation contract. Every count here is measured against the accepted, immutable Stage A snapshot annual-html-20260826 and reconciled against afldb_dev under the read-only B2-1 envelope (B2 handoff §30.1, §30.2). This file is NOT loaded by tools/migration/load_reference_data.py — it is importer configuration, not a database table, and that loader reads an explicit five-file list. It is tracked, reviewable and diffable for exactly the same reason clubs.json and seasons.json are.

matching.$comment: The source label is matched BYTE-EXACTLY. Stage A was measured to contain no empty string, no leading/trailing whitespace, no NBSP, no ZWSP and no case-variant collision across its 10 present labels, so no trimming, folding, lowercasing or normalisation is applied or permitted. Normalising here would silently admit a future label that differs only in whitespace or case, which is exactly the failure this contract exists to prevent.

absent_column.$comment: 1981, 1982 and 1987 are contract csv_schema_variants 'A' — the annual page carries NO `Draft` column at all, so parsed/rows.jsonl stores JSON null, NOT a sentinel string. The absence is itself a determinate source fact: with no Draft column the page describes a single event. afldb_dev stores all 113 of these rows as National Draft/national, and Stage A reproduces that deterministically. NO synthetic sentinel (__no_draft_column__, unknown, missing) is introduced anywhere in the import path.

draft_kind_is_not_derivable.$comment: draft_kind is NOT a mechanical transform of draft_type and must never be generated by one. 'Pre-Season' -> 'preseason' and 'Mid-Season' -> 'midseason' drop the separator, while 'Pre-Draft' -> 'pre_draft' and 'Post-Draft' -> 'post_draft' keep it. Any lowercase-and-underscore rule would emit 'pre_season'/'mid_season', silently breaking migration 069's reload key and any literal kind comparison. Enumeration is the only safe representation.

deliberate_collapse.$comment: Two display labels intentionally share one kind. 'National' (1988+, where the page HAS a Draft column) and 'National Draft' (1981/1982/1987, where it does not) are the same event kind — a national draft — so draft_kind collapses them, while draft_type preserves the distinction the source itself makes. Both columns are material and both are preserved: draft_type is user-facing (filtered, sorted and rendered), draft_kind is a query/key field. See B2 handoff §52.3 for the full consumer analysis.

totals.$comment: Reconciliation: the ten present labels plus the 113 absent-column rows must sum to the accepted Stage A population exactly.

unknown_label_policy.$comment: Fail closed. An `event_type_raw` this file does not enumerate is a HALT, never an accepted row and never a silently lowercased new kind. Adding a label is a reviewed edit to this file AND to GRID_DRAFT_TYPES in src/search/grid-solver-spec.ts, which tests/draftguru-acquisition.test.ts holds set-equal.

signing.$comment: B2 handoff §30.2 (G3, CLOSED). draft_picks.signing stores Stage A `signing_raw` verbatim; signing_kind is derived from it; signing_detail is the parenthetical remainder. Measured on afldb_dev: signing present 995, signing_kind present 995, one-sided presence 0, head-rule matches 995, head-rule mismatches 0, distinct signing values 165, signing_detail present 593. Stage A independently carries 995 signing_raw values, of which exactly 593 contain a parenthetical — the same 593.

signing.null_when: the Stage A row carries no Signing value (5,815 rows, and every row of 1997 and 1998, where the page has a Detail column instead)

signing_kind.description: the head, i.e. the source value with its first parenthetical qualifier and any whitespace before it removed
signing_kind.null_when: signing_raw is absent — absence is NEVER coerced to a kind
signing_kind.verified: 995 / 995 rows reproduce the stored value; 0 mismatches
signing_kind.vocabulary_note: Exactly the 18 values of GRID_SIGNING_KINDS in src/search/grid-solver-spec.ts, set-equal in both directions. Stage A's 165 distinct signing_raw values reduce onto precisely this set with no residue either way.
signing_kind.unknown_head_note: A head outside the vocabulary requires a reviewed edit to this file and to GRID_SIGNING_KINDS.

signing_detail.$comment: SETTLED at B2-2 as a deliberate omission, not an unresolved defect. Four candidate derivations were measured against the stored column under the read-only envelope; none reproduces it exactly. D4 (first parenthetical, inner text) reaches 593/593 only under whitespace-INSENSITIVE comparison, which is not a derivation — inventing a whitespace-normalisation rule to close that gap would create a new unsupported source-of-truth transformation for a column with zero consumers in src/. The source signing_raw is preserved verbatim, so nothing about the source is lost. See B2 handoff §57.

signing.identity_rule: signing_raw embeds player names in Father-Son (...) qualifiers, NBSP-separated. It is source payload only: it is never identity, never a matching input, and its source text is never emitted to a terminal.
